source: OWASP Top 10 2021 + AIRE Security Baseline SECURITY-01..16

criteria.constraint: No secret, token, key or credential appears in source, config or logs.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff introduces a literal credential, API key, or token, or writes one to a log.

criteria.constraint: Logs and diagnostics must not contain PII, imagery, or biometric data.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff logs a frame buffer, landmark array, face geometry, or user-identifying value.

criteria.constraint: Untrusted input is validated before use.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff consumes external input (file, env, network, config) without validating type and range.

criteria.constraint: Errors are handled without leaking internal state to the user or to an unbounded retry.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff adds a bare except that swallows an error silently, or an unbounded retry loop.

criteria.constraint: No new dependency is introduced without a pinned, vulnerability-scanned version.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff adds an unpinned dependency or one with a known critical/high advisory.

criteria.constraint: File and path handling must not permit traversal outside an intended root.
criteria.verifiableAs: Scores 0 if the diff joins user- or config-supplied input into a path without normalisation and containment.
